title: Inside a Black Hole
description: What is past the horizon, and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

puzzle.goal: A body is at rest at the horizon of a non-rotating black hole of mass M, at radius 2GM/c², and falls straight in. Inside the horizon its radial speed obeys (dr/dτ)² = c²(2GM/(c²r) − 1). Write the proper time from the horizon to the centre as an integral over r.
puzzle.name: Maximal infall proper time inside a Schwarzschild horizon
puzzle.ask: The integral evaluates to π r_s/(2c) = πGM/c³. Find it in seconds for M = @{M} kg, with G = 6.674e-11 and c = 2.998e8 (SI).
puzzle.method: Solve the radial equation for dτ = dr / |dr/dτ| and integrate from r = 0 to the horizon; substitute r = r_s sin²(η/2).
